verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents service tokens as a credential for headless agents and CI authenticating to its hosted MCP server, and the changelog shows service tokens can be managed (shown by ID). The least-privilege side of the story is unproven: no evidence describes scoping tokens to specific permissions, databases or branches. Missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes or resource restrictions, guidance on least-privilege agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use a PlanetScale service token to authenticate the hosted MCP server in CI, headless agents, and clients that send a custom HTTP header
You can now show a single service token by ID.
